resources.string: MIC: READY FOR GEMINI LIVE VOICE TURN

Phase 05 extends the verified single-turn path into a serialized foreground active conversation (Preparing, Listening, Thinking, Speaking, Paused, Error) with generation-stamped events, automatic capture restoration after speech drain, inactivity session closure, and explicit half-duplex policy.
Press Start to verify microphone & internet, connect Gemini Live, and hold an active multi-turn voice conversation.
Open Microphone Setup and Self-Test Screen
Open Gemini Live Connection and Diagnostics Screen
Stop conversation session and release hardware immediately

OmniVoice Rebuild needs microphone access to capture 16,000 Hz 16-bit mono PCM audio frames for Gemini Live voice turns and local hardware verification. Temporary self-test clips never leave the device and are deleted immediately after verification or Stop.
HONESTY BOUNDARY: Microphone self-test verifies local acoustic capture & intelligible playback only. Use the main Start button on the Conversation Shell for real Gemini Live native-audio voice turns.
